exposure: immediate breast reconstruction (IR) with tissue expander (TE) placement after mastectomy during pregnancy
mastectomy without immediate breast reconstruction during pregnancy
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 82 pregnant women with breast cancer, 29 of whom underwent mastectomy during pregnancy (10 with immediate reconstruction and 19 without).
finding: Immediate breast reconstruction after mastectomy during pregnancy increased surgery duration but was not associated with adverse obstetrical or fetal outcomes, and may preserve reconstructive options when post-mastectomy radiation is indicated.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at IR was 16.2 weeks; infants delivered at or close to term.
